name: Explore the mangrove and pause its movement
description: Verifies a scenery-only page has working motion and lighting controls, or explicitly reports unavailable WebGL instead of a blank canvas.
steps: Open the app. The page must show a mangrove scene without a coin or marketing text.
When 3D is available, click the pause control and confirm it changes to a play control; resume it.
Change the lighting to evening and back to daylight. When WebGL is unavailable, verify the static-scene notice and disabled 3D controls instead.
expected: A visible mangrove scene is present. Supported devices can pause, resume and switch light; unsupported devices clearly show the static fallback.

name: Move around and restore the view on mobile
description: Verifies mobile users can explore without scrolling the document and restore the scene controls.
steps: Open the app on mobile. When 3D is available, drag the scene horizontally and press the reset-view control.
Hide the control toolbar using its eye-off control.
Restore controls using the eye control.
expected: The page stays within the viewport. The toolbar disappears and can be restored, and on WebGL-capable devices reset restores the initial view after dragging.

name: Recover from a deliberate static fallback
description: Verifies a failed 3D initialization has a usable visible fallback and a recovery action.
steps: Open the current app URL with fallback=1 in its query string.
Confirm the static-scene notice and that motion, lighting and reset controls are disabled.
expected: The fallback is never blank. Retry starts the 3D scene and enables its controls on a supported device, or retains an explicit fallback notice and disabled 3D controls on an unsupported device.

name: Use keyboard controls and a clean background
description: Verifies controls are keyboard-accessible and the background-only URL contains no visible toolbar.
steps: Use Tab to reach a scene control and confirm focus is visible. Press H to hide controls and H again to restore them.
When the fullscreen control is available, use it to enter and exit fullscreen. A browser denial must show a visible notice rather than an uncaught error.
Open the current app URL with clean=1 in its query string.
expected: Keyboard focus is visible, H restores hidden controls, and clean mode displays the mangrove scene without toolbar, hint or show-controls button.
